title: Blocks of a concatenated chunk word
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols, let $f$ assign a cell value to each natural number, and let $m,j$ be natural numbers with $j<m$. The block at position $j$ of the word formed by concatenating the first $m$ encoded cell values is the encoded cell value $f(j)$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
$f$ maps natural numbers to cell values
